description: #5160 S8 — the page's own properties, aliases and tags head its Edit as Markdown buffer as the export's YAML front matter, and `apply_page_source` writes what the front matter changed: a changed or new key is set, a key left out deleted, the alias list replaced and a tag added or removed; a line no property reads from, a value its definition refuses and an unclosed `---` refuse the save. The buffer is the text `get_page_buffer` gives (#5160 A), its front matter kept as text carrying no id. Covers only what the tauri mock models: text values and plain list items, which both stacks render byte for byte (the keys sorted, `drop` seeded after `stage` so the order is the render's). Each successful step's `baseSource` is the page's source after the step before it. Seed: S1 (Home) > S2 (alpha), tagged S3 (work), alias `Home base`, `stage: open` (a select of open/done) and `drop: me`; S4 is the tag `idea`; both tags sit under S5 (Tags), since a root seed block's `page_id` differs between the two seed loaders. Re-author `expected` / `expected_ops` via CONFORMANCE_UPDATE=1.
name: apply_page_source_front_matter
